claim: A standard 2-day Hangzhou structure puts West Lake (Three Pools Mirroring the Moon, boat ride) plus an evening cultural performance on day 1, and Lingyin Temple plus Hefang Street on day 2.
quote: Day 1 typically involves exploring West Lake, visiting the Three Pools Mirroring the Moon, enjoying a boat ride, and attending a cultural performance in the evening. Day 2 usually includes visiting Lingyin Temple, exploring Hefang Street, and shopping for souvenirs.

claim: Lingyin Temple opens around 7:00 AM and is best visited 7:00-9:00 AM for soft mist and fewer crowds; by 10 AM the main halls are crowded, so an early-morning slot on day 2 is the crowd-avoidance move.
quote: morning hours from 7:00–9:00 AM offer soft mist, cool tones, and fewer crowds. By 10 AM, the main halls are crowded... Late afternoon (after 3 PM) is a reasonable alternative if you're not a morning person.

claim: Local guides recommend starting at Broken Bridge before 7:30 AM for empty, misty shots, then walking Bai Causeway and Gushan Hill to Su Causeway, taking a midday boat to Three Pools, and saving Leifeng Pagoda for sunset after 4:30 PM.
quote: Start at Broken Bridge Remnant Snow... Few people in the early morning... Progress to Bai Causeway and Gushan Hill, then continue to Su Causeway... Visit Leifeng Pagoda during sunset hours... West Lake under the sunset is super gentle

claim: Because Hangzhou is a top domestic-tourist city, West Lake core areas feel busy from late morning through afternoon and weekends/Chinese public holidays should be avoided; starting early keeps the lake walk enjoyable.
quote: steer clear of the weekends and Chinese public holidays, as Hangzhou is one of the most popular destinations for domestic visitors... West Lake core areas can feel busy from late morning through the afternoon, so starting earlier keeps your lake walk enjoyable.

claim: The Impression West Lake (Enduring Memories of Hangzhou) night show, directed by Zhang Yimou, runs early March to end of December at 19:40 and 21:10, lasts 55 minutes, and tickets (CNY 360-960) sell out fast, so it must be booked ahead.
quote: performances usually held daily at 19:40 and 21:10. The performance lasts 55 minutes. Ticket prices range from CNY 360 for standard seating to CNY 960 for premium seating. Tickets tend to sell out quickly... advisable to book in advance.

claim: An alternative 2-day sequencing front-loads both marquee sights on day 1 (morning West Lake boat + Leifeng Pagoda, afternoon Lingyin Temple, evening Hefang Street) and reserves day 2 for slower stops like the China National Silk Museum and Xixi Wetland Park.
quote: Day 1 Morning: Begin your journey with a scenic boat ride on West Lake... Afternoon: Visit Lingyin Temple... Evening: Stroll along Hefang Street... Day 2 Morning: Tour the China National Silk Museum... Afternoon: Xixi National Wetland Park.

claim: Free evening alternatives to the paid show include the music fountain at Third Park on the eastern lakeside, making an early-evening lakeside stroll a natural lead-in before a special dinner.
quote: Evening ideas include watching the 'Enduring Memories of Hangzhou'... (usually starting at 7pm), or viewing the free Music Fountain Show at Third Park near the eastern lakeside of West Lake.
